title: Food Fight Arena — Build
subtitle: Per-element critic loops — each part built and judged independently

active.detail: Every element now has its own owner agent running its own build-critique-fix loop to 7/10, judged by a fresh independent critic each round. HUD has already beaten the shipped reference in a blind test. The arena is being split into per-element modules so its parts can loop in parallel too.

notes: Every element is judged by a FRESH critic each round, so it cannot anchor on its own earlier verdicts.
Builder self-scores are not verdicts — they have run 2-4 points above independent critics all project.
When a critic says "X is not there", check whether X is rendering and invisible before concluding it is missing. That has been the true cause three separate times.
Element scores will read higher than the whole, because a critic judging one prop is not weighing composition. The whole-arena scan stays the real measure.
